description: Show a set of inventory items as a visual picker: a photo list in which each row carries the item's name, the code printed on its asset tag, its condition and where it is. It suits a choice between items or a request to see them ("which drill can I take?", "show me the beamers in the Aula"), and items that share a name, which the photos, codes and rooms tell apart. `itemIds` are ids from search_items rows (up to 24, shown in the given order); `title` is an optional caption; `total` is the size of the full result when only part of it is shown (the card says "Showing 8 of 40"). Every row carries `photoUrl`, the item's main photo (absent when it has none); this tool and get_item are the only tools that return item photos, and get_item shows a single item. Display only: it writes nothing and does not search. Personal drafts are never shown. Hosts that render widgets draw the picker; other clients receive the same rows as text.

itemIds.description: Item ids from search_items rows, in display order (max 24)

title.description: Short caption naming the list, e.g. "Beamers in Room 204"

total.description: Total matches behind this selection when only some are shown; the card says "Showing 8 of 40"

name: show_items
title: Show items
